verses.zh: 谷神不死，是谓玄牝。玄牝之门，是谓天地根。绵绵若存，用之不勤。
verses.en: The valley spirit dies not, aye the same; The female mystery thus do we name. Its gate, from which at first they issued forth, Is called the root from which grew heaven and earth. Long and unbroken does its power remain, Used gently, and without the touch of pain.
